name: Raven ~Inoru Shoujo o Otosu Jutsu~
source:
Main character studies black magic at school. An angel sends computer virus from heavenly world and disturbs research. Protagonist becomes an access point thanks to the virus. With that he captures a devil and with her help they beat the angel and inject her with "Anti-Mercy Virus". 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在学校学习黑魔法。天使从天界发送电脑病毒，干扰了他的研究。主人公借助病毒成为一个接入点，并以此捕获了一名恶魔。在恶魔的帮助下，他们击败了天使，并向她注入“反慈悲病毒”。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
